description: This Java source file defines a servlet class named DeleteCustomer, which handles HTTP POST requests to delete a customer record based on customer ID, interacting with the CustomerDBUtil to perform the database deletion and managing HTTP responses accordingly.

classes.name: DeleteCustomer
classes.description: A servlet handling deletion of customer records via HTTP POST, forwarding requests or redirecting based on deletion success.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Processes HTTP POST requests to delete a customer identified by 'CusID'. Calls external utility to perform deletion and responds with redirect or error message.
